title: tc-agent-lanes
description: Every agent as a lane on a live timeline, with decisions in place.

agents.description: The agents, one lane each from top to bottom – name, model and an optional avatar

tasks.description: The tasks – always the source of truth. After Approve or Reject the block shows the result right away; as soon as you pass that task with a new status, start or end, your version wins

span.description: How much time the lanes show, in ms (default 30 minutes)

now.description: A clock you control, in epoch ms. Without it the lanes follow real time

rate.description: How fast the clock runs, in clock ms per real ms: on from `now` when set (default 0), from real time otherwise (default 1)

openable.description: Shows "Open" in a block's details; pressing it fires tc-open

paused.description: Whether the timeline is held still. Changed by the Pause button unless a tc-paused-change listener calls preventDefault(). The lanes also hold still while the pointer or focus is on them (WCAG 2.2.2)

expanded.description: The id of the block whose decision or details are open (null: none). Changed by the user unless a tc-expanded-change listener calls preventDefault()

heading.description: The title on the summary bar

model.description: Model or role, shown under the name, e.g. "Opus 5.5"

end.description: Leave it out while the task runs or waits – it then reaches "now"

handoffTo.description: Id of the task another agent picked up from this one – drawn as a hand-off curve

ask.description: What exactly needs a decision, shown above Approve / Reject

summary.description: What got done so far, a few words each – shown in the details popover

tools.description: Small logos of the tools it works in (cloned), shown before the title – up to three
